countryCode.meaning: user-selected country or territory context; not inferred from language

currencyCode.meaning: currency denomination; symbol is presentation only

financialJurisdiction.meaning: explicit legal/tax/financial jurisdiction for a specific calculation

invariants: Language does not infer country, currency, tax residence or measurement system.
Country may suggest a primary currency but user may override it.
Changing currency does not convert an amount; conversion is a separate explicit operation with dated FX provenance.
Only money fields carry a currencyCode; percentages, quantities and physical units do not.
No policy rate may be substituted for a retail deposit or lending rate.
External values are suggestions with provenance; manual override is always available.
Never replace a user-edited value during background refresh.
Existing BDT defaults remain unchanged until a tool-by-tool migration is approved and tested.

conditionalRules: If inputOrigin is external-source, sourceId and retrievedAt are required; preserve observationDate and/or publication/effective dates when supplied by the provider.
If inputOrigin is user-manual, sourceId is not required, freshnessState must be not-applicable, and enteredAt should be recorded.
If unit is currency-amount, currencyCode is required.
If unit is an FX rate, baseCurrencyCode and quoteCurrencyCode are required and must be different.
If the metric is jurisdiction-specific, countryCode or an explicit subdivision is required; global or multi-country series may use geographicScope without a single countryCode.
If inputOrigin is illustrative-example, the value must be visibly labelled illustrative and must not be presented as a current sourced rate.

limitations: blended reference rate is not official
CORS and rate limits require browser-origin verification

candidateProviders.purpose: ECB official statistical series including EUR reference FX
limitations: not a universal global retail finance API
CORS and exact series must be verified
exact indicator metadata and frequency required

candidateProviders.purpose: BIS statistical series including monetary policy rates
limitations: policy rates are not retail deposit rates
BIS terms and CORS require review

prohibitedShortcuts: infer deposit rate from country or currency
use central-bank policy rate as bank deposit offer
use search snippets as verified values
silently convert existing amounts on currency change
treat stale cached data as current
ship secret API keys in static client code
scrape pages where terms prohibit it or bypass CORS
